decisions.reason: It remains tightly aligned with the firm's office and conference know-how, and several years of learning should have strengthened its ability to refine and commercialize the system successfully.

Although it is still the most niche of the surviving products, it draws on the firm's material, upholstery, and interior-concept capabilities enough to justify retention while it complements the broader portfolio.

The high standing table fits the firm's direction toward flexible workplace interiors, and the firm's existing design and product-development knowledge makes continued adaptation and market support relatively straightforward.
